name: firestore-admin-getfirestore-bypass-and-lifecycle
description: firebase-admin/firestore getFirestore(app) caches one Firestore handle per active app, isolates handles across apps, throws TypeError on non-app objects/null, bypasses Firestore Security Rules that deny unauthenticated client reads with permission-denied, and throws app/app-deleted synchronously after deleteApp(app) while preserving sibling apps.
